زَلِقٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- Applied to a man, Quickly angry (O, K) at what is said. (O) ―
-b3- And, (T, S, K,) as also ↓ زُمَلِقٌ (T, S, and K in art. زملق) and ↓ زُمَّلِقٌ and ↓ زُمَالِقٌ , (S, and K in art. زملق,) applied to a man, (T, S,) Qui semen emittit quum verba mulieri facit, sine congressu: (T, TA:) or qui semen emittit ante initum. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
